mines.mine_notes: Open-pit copper-gold mine (flotation), north-central British Columbia. FY2025: 147.6 koz payable gold sold; total capital expenditures $80.5M; gold production cost $1,388/oz; AISC $1,194/oz (by-product basis). Royal Gold streaming agreement: Royal Gold entitled to 35% of gold ounces and 18.75% of copper pounds sold (pays $435/oz gold and 15% of spot copper). Mine life extended into 2036 (announced Feb 2025); P&P gold reserves grew to 4.294 Moz and copper to 1.716 Blbs, reducing DDA. Head grade not disclosed in AIF at mine level (reserve grade 0.28 g/t Au, 0.17% Cu).

Open-pit gold mine with heap-leach processing (adsorption/desorption/refining on site), Kayseri province, Türkiye. Main deposit Keltepe (~90% of contained gold). FY2025: gold production cost $1,199/oz; AISC $1,613/oz (by-product basis); total capital expenditures $38.3M. Full operations resumed June 2023 after May 2023 EIA approval. Turkish corporate tax rate on the mine 24% (25% less 1% industrial registry reduction).

Molybdenum mine, Idaho. On care and maintenance; P&P Mo reserves 112.989 Mt @ 0.065% = 161 Mlbs Mo. Company announced Sept 2023 PFS and Sept 2024 feasibility study/strategic integrated business plan for a molybdenum business unit restart (Thompson Creek Mine restart + Langeloth Metallurgical Facility ramp-up). No FY2025 production.

Molybdenum mine, British Columbia (75% interest). On care and maintenance since July 1, 2015; ~10 employees as of Dec 31, 2025. M&I Mo resources 166 Mlbs (50.522 Mt @ 0.074% measured + 122.175 Mt @ 0.040% indicated).

Gold-copper development project, north-central BC (100%). PEA announced Jan 19, 2026: 15-year mine life, open pit first then underground ~2 years later; avg annual production 171 koz gold + 61 Mlbs copper; AISC $971/oz (by-product basis); after-tax NPV5% ~$1.1B and IRR ~16% at $3,000/oz Au, $4.50/lb Cu; initial non-sustaining capex $771M + $277M expansion capex. PFS expected 2027. M&I resources (inclusive): Main open pit 170.513 Mt @ 0.30 g/t Au (1,668 koz), South open pit 13.204 Mt (158 koz), underground 33.223 Mt @ 0.82 g/t (877 koz), Kemess East 27.491 Mt @ 0.64 g/t (565 koz); indicated copper 1,146 Mlbs, silver 10.78 Moz. Q4 2025 impairment reversal $144.8M.

Gold development project, Nevada (100%). Technical study announced Aug 6, 2025; company proceeding with development. P&P reserves 33.348 Mt @ 0.66 g/t = 706 koz Au. FY2025 technical study forecasts ~7-year mine life, avg annual gold production ~100 koz between 2029 and 2032, life-of-mine AISC $1,392/oz; first production expected by end of 2028; total 533 koz gold. Hedging strategy covers 50% of 2029-2030 gold production with $3,200/oz floor and $4,435/oz average cap.

notes: FY2025 consolidated: 275,316 oz gold production (147,582 Mount Milligan + 127,734 Öksüt), 50.5 Mlbs copper; gold production costs $1,297/oz; AISC $1,614/oz (by-product basis); AISC co-product $1,872/oz gold / $2.56/lb copper. Royal Gold stream affects attributable economics at Mount Milligan. FY2025 impairment reversal $144.8M (Kemess, Q4). Company sold 50% interest in Greenstone Gold Mines (gold delivery commitment tied to ounces received by Centerra). Exploration & evaluation: Kemess project (Canada). Pure-exploration properties excluded.
